caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brown wooden box with ornate carvings on its sides and lid. The lid features intricate carved designs, possibly portraying floral and leafy patterns, and the top surface is bordered by a raised edge. The sides of the box display further carving, with the front panel showing two birds facing inward toward a central leafy motif. The corners of the box have a beveled design, and the bottom edge is scalloped, with cut-out shapes forming a decorative base. The box is rendered in various shades of brown, giving the appearance of natural wood grain, and there is a small, handwritten signature in red ink located to the lower right of the box on the neutral, light beige background.
title: Pa. German Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
